strings.name: Leonardo DiCaprio
strings.summary: Raised in Los Angeles, DiCaprio moved from advertising and television into film. What’s Eating Gilbert Grape brought attention and Titanic global fame. Long collaborations with Scorsese and others span crime, history and psychology; The Revenant earned him the leading-actor Oscar. Beyond production, he funds conservation and advocates climate action as a United Nations Messenger of Peace.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Gained global influence through films including Titanic and The Revenant while consistently supporting public environmental advocacy.
